items.title: Backend Unit Lead
items.content_html:
TradingView is the world’s largest financial analysis platform with more than 100M users across 180+ countries.

We build tools that help traders and investors make informed decisions — from advanced charting and market data to collaboration and publishing features. Our products are used daily by millions of individuals and trusted by companies like Revolut, Binance, and CME Group.

We’re continuing to grow and scale our platform, and we’re looking for people who care about product quality, take ownership of their work, and want to build systems used by a global audience.

About the team

We are looking for an experienced Unit Lead to take on technical and organizational leadership across the unit. This is a true "leader of leaders" role focused on technical strategy, reliability, people development, and process maturity. While your direct reports will be Team Leads and Tech Leads, we expect you to remain technically grounded with a deep understanding of system design, distributed architectures, and codebase fundamentals.

Your mission will be to align the teams under a single strategic vision, drive cross-team synergies, balance product delivery with technical debt and reliability, and grow future engineering leaders in a high-ownership, high-scale environment.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute the unit's technical strategy and roadmap, translating company business objectives into clear, measurable engineering goals and delivery milestones.

  • Unify multiple engineering teams around a shared runtime and platform architecture, maximizing synergies and eliminating inter-team dependencies.

  • Directly manage and mentor Team Leads; conduct regular 1:1s, support their managerial growth, and guide their progression through engineering grades.

  • Own resource management across the unit: run hiring, onboarding, capacity planning, and headcount budgeting; justify compensation adjustments and ensure teams are staffed to deliver on commitments.

  • Foster a culture of high ownership, accountability, transparency, and continuous learning across all teams within the unit.

  • Own platform reliability and technical health: define and enforce SLOs/SLAs, availability and latency targets, incident post-mortems, and a robust on-call culture.

  • Drive Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP): define RTO/RPO targets, design dual-hub/failover scenarios, and oversee regular readiness checks.

  • Supervise capacity forecasting, scaling, and operations on Kubernetes and cloud platforms while optimizing the total cost of ownership (TCO).

  • Optimize engineering workflows, implementing modern delivery frameworks, release metrics, quality controls, and effective requirements management.

  • Represent the unit at the company and executive level; proactively work with stakeholders (product managers, adjacent engineering departments) to align on roadmaps, architectural trade-offs, and risks

What makes you the perfect fit

  • 5+ years of experience in engineering management (Unit Lead / Engineering Manager), ideally with experience managing Team Leads / Tech Leads and multiple teams simultaneously.

  • Strong background in backend development (Go or Java) and a proven track record of building and managing distributed systems at scale.

  • Deep experience with high-load, low-latency services in a production environment.

  • Solid understanding of SRE practices: SLO/SLA formulation, observability, incident management, and building an on-call culture.

  • Confident practical understanding of capacity planning, resource allocation, and operations within Kubernetes and cloud/container infrastructures.

  • Proven ability to define strategy, set OKRs, and build transparent processes for performance reviews and engineer growth (PDPs).

  • Excellent systems thinking, high comfort level in managing ambiguity, and strong prioritization skills.

  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively bridge technical teams and business leadership.

  • Working-level Russian and English (for internal communication, meetings, and technical documentation).

Will be a plus

  • Experience in finance or trading domain

  • Familiarity with TradingView as a product

  • Hands-on experience with DR planning and capacity profiling.

  • Experience consolidating or reorganizing several teams into a single unit.

  • Familiarity with the technologies in the stack below.

What we offer you

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work format

  • Well-equipped offices for focused and collaborative work

  • A global, distributed team of 500+ professionals

  • Learning, mentorship, and long-term career growth

  • Relocation support and private health insurance

  • Performance-based bonuses

  • TradingView Premium access

  • Regular team events and company-wide meetups

Join the TradingView team and help us build a product used by millions of traders and investors worldwide. We look forward to hearing from you!

TradingView is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Our success is driven by 600+ professionals from 40+ countries who speak nearly 20 languages.

items.title: Growth & Partnership Specialist (B2B) - France & Benelux
items.content_html:
TradingView is the world’s largest financial analysis platform with more than 100M users across 180+ countries.

We build tools that help traders and investors make informed decisions — from advanced charting and market data to collaboration and publishing features. Our products are used daily by millions of individuals and trusted by companies like Revolut, Binance, and CME Group.

We’re continuing to grow and scale our platform, and we’re looking for people who care about product quality, take ownership of their work, and want to build systems used by a global audience.

About the team

We are looking for a Growth & Partnerships Specialist to own and grow TradingView’s B2B business in France & Benelux, as part of our Europe-Latam Growth team.

This is a sales role at its core. You will sell and promote TradingView’s B2B products to brokers, exchanges and fintech platforms, close deals end to end, and keep growing every partnership after signature. You will be the face of TradingView in your markets and the person partners trust.

You will carry your own numbers — integrations and revenue — and have real freedom in how you hit them.

Responsibilities

Sell and promote TradingView

  • Pitch the full range of TradingView B2B products and partnership opportunities to financial institutions, brokers, exchanges and fintech platforms.

  • Inspire partners with our mission: how TradingView changes the way people trade and makes trading accessible to millions.

  • Turn interest into signed, paid deals: run commercial negotiations, align contracts with legal teams on both sides, and see each deal through to invoice payment.

  • Hit ambitious quarterly targets for completed integrations and commercial performance.

Build and run your pipeline

  • Build and run your own outbound pipeline across France/Benelux

  • Manage inbound partnership requests from first contact through to signed agreement.

  • Diagnose each partner’s commercial goals and priorities before proposing anything, and build the pitch and offer around them.

  • Run many deals in parallel — from quick wins like a widget integration to large strategic partnerships.

Grow partners after signature

  • Carry partners through technical integration until the deal produces volume, not just until signature, keeping communication with technical teams clear and client-friendly.

  • Stay close to partners after launch, find new opportunities and expand each relationship.

  • Collect market signals from partners and feed them back to product and business teams.

  • Own a rigorous test-and-learn approach: measure, adjust, and quickly drop what does not work.

  • Travel across France and Benelux to meet partners and represent TradingView at industry events.

    What makes you the perfect fit

  • 3+ years in B2B sales, business development or partnerships.

  • A track record of closing deals end to end with brokers, exchanges, fintech companies or other financial institutions — from first conversation to signed contract and payment.

  • Working knowledge of financial markets, trading platforms and brokerage ecosystems in France & Benelux; an existing network there is a strong plus.

  • You are familiar with TradingView and understand our product from the user’s perspective.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment: you juggle many deals at once, switch quickly between tasks, and keep things moving even when not all the information is available.

  • A self-starter who takes ownership, works independently and consistently delivers on targets.

  • Excellent spoken and written English; French is required.

  • Hands-on experience with a CRM.

What we offer

  • Location: Paris (remote) - B2B contract

  • Compensation: competitive base salary plus a performance bonus tied to your targets.

  • Ongoing training, mentoring and growth alongside experienced colleagues.

  • Premium TradingView subscription as part of your package.

TradingView is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Our success is driven by 600+ professionals from 40+ countries who speak nearly 20 languages.
